same_state_requirements: support observer age and pulse latch
pulse_condition: Earlier right pitch pulse on the current support interval. Extend only while the right support classifier, pre-action gyro and audited target headroom remain valid.
diagnostic_contact_usage: Use actual contact only to match cohorts and independently score support timing. The pulse arm reads normal sensor and target inputs.
advance_condition: In both low-friction seeds the sustained arm must produce a larger 160 ms median absolute yaw reduction than one additional control and exceed the paired zero-repeat 95th percentile, preserving original physical gates.
